name: Sanctuary Decision Trends
description: Coarse allow and deny trends for XDM-shaped Sanctuary audit exports.

widgets.title: Decision trend
widgets.query: dataset = sanctuary_audit_raw | comp count() by bin(_time, 1h), sanctuary.audit.decision

widgets.title: Recent denied operations
widgets.query: dataset = sanctuary_audit_raw | filter sanctuary.audit.decision = "deny" | fields _time, xdm.event.operation, xdm.event.outcome, sanctuary.audit.result
